_doc: Operator's source of truth for elseware.app/launch-status. Update this file, run `node scripts/render-launch-status.js`, commit, push. Vercel auto-deploys. The page is the public 'build-in-public' amplifier — every number visible is honest. If you stop updating it, the public will see stale dates. That's the truth-telling cost we accept.
